| description = Sir Hobble is a High Elven Paladin involved in the Wurmslayer quest. Hailing him spawns Squire Fuzzmin, who starts and finishes the quest.

In the Firiona Vie outpost, find [[Lenka_Stoutheart_(Firiona_Vie)|Lenka Stoutheart]]. She is a barbarian woman in the same hut as an ogre and dwarf. Hail her. Ask her to "show me something interesting". She will begin to tell another dialogue string, but just ignore her and leave. By asking her about "something interesting" you have triggered the spawning of Sir Hobble.

Now head out into the wilderness to the east, preferably with a tracker. When you find Sir Hobble, hail him. He will say something about Squire Fizzmin. Hailing Sir Hobble spawns Squire Fizzmin in town. Keep following Sir Hobble. Squire Fizzmin will make a bee-line to wherever Sir Hobble is.

Unfortunately, Squire Fizzmin will be too busy helping and following Sir Hobble for you to be able to do much more than hail him and speak of few key phrases. Trying to give him the scales was a pain while he was running along.

Keep following them and help them kill any mobs that double-team them. They are tough and can handle most solo mobs. Once Sir Hobble and the Squire complete their "circuit" of the zone, Squire Fizzmin will break away and head back towards town. Follow him until he comes to a stop and complete the quest. For me, he came to a stop behind the big temple looking building.[http://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=5328#m99703882690762]
